map.制动距离=v₀²/(2a)，与速度平方成正比。速度从 20 变到 40 m/s: Braking distance = v₀²/(2a), proportional to the square of speed. Going from 20 to 40 m/s raises the braking leg from 40.00 m to 160.00 m. That is exactly why you must open a much larger gap at high speed — the danger does not grow linearly.
